hero.title: COALA-SwarmOPS
hero.subtitle: AI Agent Ecosystem
hero.description: Orchestrate your own AI agent ecosystem. Save money on agents, scale your projects, and keep full control with our battle-tested configuration.
hero.tagline: Stop paying for individual agents. Coordinate them all.

problem.title: Tired of static AI agents?
problem.subtitle: The traditional development problem
problem.description: Traditional workflows force you to choose ONE agent at a time. Switching context costs money, time, and sanity. With static tools, every task needs a new prompt, a new context, a new cost.

features.title: No coordination
features.description: Agents work in isolation, never sharing context or results.

features.title: Hidden costs
features.description: Every agent switch means rebuilding context from scratch.

features.title: Lost time
features.description: Manually switching between tools breaks your development flow.

staticItems: One agent per task, no coordination
Steep learning curve for each tool
swarmItems: Multiple agents collaborating as a team

solution.title: An ecosystem that works for you
solution.subtitle: Intelligent multi-agent coordination
solution.description: COALA-SwarmOPS coordinates multiple specialized agents like an ecosystem. Each agent does what it does best, automatically sharing context. You just request the feature — the ecosystem executes it.

features.title: v6.0 — Custom Modes
features.description: 19 specialized modes across T0 to T3 tiers. Each mode is an expert agent in its domain.

features.title: v6.5 — Circuit Breakers
features.description: Cascading failure protection. If an agent fails 2 times, it's automatically isolated.

features.title: v6.7 — CoALA Swarm
features.description: Full decision cycle: Propose → Evaluate → Select → Execute with working memory.

howItWorks.title: How the ecosystem works
howItWorks.subtitle: 3 steps to tame complexity
howItWorks.description: Install in 5 minutes. Our custom configuration comes pre-built with 19 battle-tested modes. You only need your API key and a project folder. [Installation guide →](https://github.com/Aquilesnake/COALA-SwarmOps/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md)

steps.title: Install
steps.description: Clone the repo, set up your API key. 5 minutes and you're ready.

steps.title: Describe your feature
steps.description: Write what you need in natural language. The swarm understands the context.

steps.title: The ecosystem executes
steps.description: Agents coordinate on their own. You only review the final result.

modesShowcase.title: 19 modes. One ecosystem.
modesShowcase.subtitle: Each agent is a specialist in its task
modesShowcase.description: From simple T0 execution to T3 strategic planning. Every mode is optimized for its specific task, with the right model at the right cost.

whoIsItFor.title: Who is COALA-SwarmOPS for?

whoIsItFor.description: Whether you're just starting out or running a company, we have a configuration that fits your level. [Explore the full README →](https://github.com/Aquilesnake/COALA-SwarmOps/blob/main/README_ES.md)

pricing.title: Free. Open Source. Forever.
pricing.subtitle: Only pay for the tokens you consume
pricing.description: COALA-SwarmOPS is 100% open source. You only pay for the models you choose to use (API tokens). If you use local models like Granite, the cost is ZERO.

tiers.name: Cloud Models (T0.5–T3)
tiers.description: Scale to more powerful models when you need advanced reasoning.

pricing.freeMessage: Free forever. No credit card required.
